_doc: Perks (SPEC §5): at skill levels 5, 10, 15 and 20 the character picks one of two. ids are '<skill>.<name>' (sim/skills.ts counts open slots by that prefix). effects is a small vocabulary read by sim/economy/perks.ts, each value a fraction applied to actions of the perk's own skill unless noted: speed (work goes faster), yield (more output), quality (craft quality score), xp (experience gain), wear (less tool wear), save (inputs saved), sell / buy (prices when selling / buying), fee (fees, tolls, multure and fines reduced), rent (rent reduced), rentIncome (rent collected), fine (fines reduced), fertility (soil recovers faster), breed (livestock breed better), fodder (winter fodder saved), carry (carrying capacity), wage (wages earned), heal (care works better), xpAll (experience in every skill), helper (hired and household helpers work better). Keys for wave 3 skills (accuracy, damage, morale, detect, charm, travel) are data for now.

perks.name: Hardy Hands
perks.description: Years at the plough-tail toughen the palms. Field work goes 10% faster.

perks.name: Weather-Wise
perks.description: You read the sky and the swallows. Crops are sown and cut at the right time: 6% more grain.

perks.name: Ridge and Furrow
perks.description: Well-turned ridges drain the wet and warm the seed. Ploughing and harrowing are 12% faster and the crop 5% heavier.

perks.name: Sure Sower
perks.description: An even cast wastes no corn. 15% of the seed is saved at every sowing.

perks.name: Master Reaper
perks.description: Leading the reapers, you cut clean and leave no ears behind. 15% faster and 8% more grain.

perks.name: Three-Field Wisdom
perks.description: You know what fallow and the pea crop give back to tired soil. Fields recover half as fast again and yield 8% more.

perks.name: Husbandman of Note
perks.description: The whole hundred asks your counsel at sowing time. Every harvest is 15% larger.

perks.name: The Reeve's Confidence
perks.description: The lord's officers trust your tally. Rents are 15% lower and the harvest 5% larger.

perks.name: Gentle Hand
perks.description: The cows let down for you. Milk and eggs come 10% richer.

perks.name: Sheep Sense
perks.description: You know a sound fleece at a glance. Shearing and herding go 12% faster.

perks.name: Careful Breeder
perks.description: You choose the sire and watch the dam. Livestock breed 20% better.

perks.name: Fodder Keeper
perks.description: You stack the hay so it lasts. Winter fodder lasts 20% longer.

perks.name: Drover
perks.description: You know the drove roads and the fair-day buyers. Herding is 25% faster and beasts sell for 8% more.

perks.name: Dairy Mistress
perks.description: Your cheeses are sought after at three markets. Dairy work gives 25% more.

perks.name: Master Herdsman
perks.description: No murrain touches your flock for long. Livestock breed 30% better.

perks.name: Stapler's Friend
perks.description: The wool merchants pay a premium for your clip: 15% better prices for what you raise.

perks.name: Keen Tracker
perks.description: You read slots and droppings like a page. Game is easier to find.

perks.name: Snare Setter
perks.description: Hares and fowl come to your snares. 10% more from the hunt.

perks.name: Forester's Eye
perks.description: You know where the deer lie up. Shots at game land truer.

perks.name: Fisher's Luck
perks.description: The pike come to your weirs. 15% more fish from the water.

perks.name: Skinner
perks.description: A clean knife saves the whole hide. Hides and meat bring 20% more.

perks.name: Quiet Step
perks.description: You move through the wood like a shadow. Game and keepers notice you less.

perks.name: Master of the Chase
perks.description: Lords seek you to lead the hunt. Your hunting arrows bite 10% harder.

perks.name: Warden of the Wood
perks.description: The woodward counts you as one of his own. Woodland fines are halved.

perks.name: Sharp Axe
perks.description: You keep your edge honed. Axes wear 25% slower.

perks.name: Strong Swing
perks.description: Each blow bites deeper. Felling goes 10% faster.

perks.name: Fell with Care
perks.description: You drop the trunk where you mean to and waste no timber. 10% more from every tree.

perks.name: Faggot-Maker
perks.description: Neat bundles, tight bound. Gathering wood goes 20% faster.

perks.name: Forester
perks.description: You know which trees may be taken and whom to ask. Stumpage fees are halved.

perks.name: Charcoal Burner
perks.description: Your mounds burn slow and even. 20% more charcoal from the same wood.

perks.name: Master Woodsman
perks.description: The wood answers your axe. 20% faster and 10% more timber.

perks.name: King's Verderer's Man
perks.description: You hold a verderer's favour. Forest fines against you are halved.

perks.name: Strong Back
perks.description: You carry the spoil without stooping. Heavy work tires you 15% less.

perks.name: Eye for Ore
perks.description: You spot the rusty seam in grey rock. 10% more ore and stone.

perks.name: Hard Pick
perks.description: A well-swung pick splits the face cleanly. 12% faster.

perks.name: Timber the Shaft
perks.description: Good props and no cave-ins. Picks wear 25% slower.

perks.name: Vein-Reader
perks.description: You follow the rich vein and leave the dead rock. 15% more ore.

perks.name: Quarryman
perks.description: You know where a block will split true. 20% more usable stone.

perks.name: Master Miner
perks.description: The gaffer's right hand. 20% faster and 10% more from the rock.

perks.name: Deep Lore
perks.description: Old miners' secrets of air and water. Tools wear half as fast.

perks.name: Steady Hammer
perks.description: Blow after even blow. Your ironwork comes out a little finer.

perks.name: Fire-Tender
perks.description: You know just how hot the forge should be. Saves a tenth of the charcoal and iron.

perks.name: Edge and Temper
perks.description: Quench at the right colour and the edge holds. Quality up a quarter tier.

perks.name: Swift Forge
perks.description: Heat, strike, reheat: you waste no motion. 15% faster at the anvil.

perks.name: Master of Iron
perks.description: You draw out a bar with hardly a flaw. Saves 15% of the iron and lifts quality a fifth of a tier.

perks.name: Farrier's Art
perks.description: Every horse in the shire is shod by you. Your smithwork sells for 8% more.

perks.name: Masterwork Hand
perks.description: Pieces from your forge are spoken of by lords. Quality up half a tier.

perks.name: Warden's Forge
perks.description: Guild dues are waived for the warden. Fees halved and 10% faster.

perks.name: True Cut
perks.description: You mark twice and cut once. Saves a tenth of the timber and planks.

perks.name: Sharp Saw
perks.description: A well-set saw bites clean. Saws and chisels wear 25% slower.

perks.name: Joiner
perks.description: Your mortices fit without a gap. Quality up a fifth of a tier.

perks.name: Swift Sawyer
perks.description: Top-sawyer and pit-sawyer in step. 15% faster.

perks.name: Master Framer
perks.description: You get more planks from every log. 15% more.

perks.name: Wheelwright's Secret
perks.description: Hubs, spokes and felloes that last a lifetime. Quality up a fifth of a tier.

perks.name: Master Carpenter
perks.description: Your roofs outlast their builders. Quality up two fifths of a tier.

perks.name: Shipwright's Eye
perks.description: You see a curve in a crooked bough. 20% faster and a tenth of the wood saved.

perks.name: Keen Chisel
perks.description: A good edge and a light mallet. Chisels wear 25% slower.

perks.name: Stonewise
perks.description: You know the bed of a stone. 10% more usable blocks.

perks.name: Fine Dresser
perks.description: Faces so true they need no mortar. Quality up a fifth of a tier.

perks.name: Lime and Mortar
perks.description: You mix mortar that sets like rock. A tenth of the materials saved.

perks.name: Freemason
perks.description: Lodge brothers pass you through every gate. Fees and tolls are 30% lower.

perks.name: Vault-Builder
perks.description: Ribs and bosses come easy. 15% faster.

perks.name: Master Mason
perks.description: Your work stands for centuries. Quality up two fifths of a tier.

perks.name: Cathedral Builder
perks.description: Bishops and abbots pay well for your name. Stone and masonry sell for 15% more.

perks.name: Nimble Fingers
perks.description: Needle and distaff fly. Spinning, weaving and sewing go 10% faster.

perks.name: Thrifty Cutter
perks.description: Nothing goes to the rag-bag. A tenth of the cloth and yarn saved.

perks.name: Fine Stitch
perks.description: Seams lie flat and last. Quality up a fifth of a tier.

perks.name: Spinner's Rhythm
perks.description: A steady hand makes even thread. 15% faster at the wheel and loom.

perks.name: Dyer's Secret
perks.description: Woad, madder and weld in the right measure. Your garments carry more status: quality up three tenths of a tier.

perks.name: Weaver's Pride
perks.description: Tight cloth with no loose ends. 15% more cloth from the yarn.

perks.name: Master Tailor
perks.description: Gentry send to you for their gowns. Quality up two fifths of a tier.

perks.name: Draper's Friend
perks.description: The drapers take all you make at a better price: 12% more.

perks.name: Clean Vat
perks.description: No sour batches in your house. 10% more ale and bread from each batch.

perks.name: Good Barm
perks.description: Your yeast is lively and sweet. Brews and bakes come out a little finer.

perks.name: Thrifty Brewer
perks.description: You stretch the malt without thinning the ale. A seventh of the grain and fuel saved.

perks.name: Baker's Hand
perks.description: You know your oven. 15% faster at kneading and baking.

perks.name: Alewife of Repute
perks.description: Folk walk miles for your ale. It sells for 10% more.

perks.name: Herb Garden
perks.description: Hops, sage and thyme grow by your door. Quality up a quarter tier.

perks.name: Master Brewer
perks.description: Strong ale fit for an abbot's table. 25% more from every batch.

perks.name: Abbey Recipe
perks.description: A monk's secret passed to you. Ale and bread sell for 15% more and you learn 15% faster.

perks.name: Haggler
perks.description: You never take the first price. Buy 5% cheaper and sell 5% dearer.

perks.name: Sharp Eye
perks.description: You spot a false weight at twenty paces. Market fees are 10% lower.

perks.name: Honest Weights
perks.description: Buyers trust your scales. Sell for 6% more at market.

perks.name: Peddler's Pack
perks.description: A well-packed bundle holds a fifth more.

perks.name: Guild Connections
perks.description: Guild brothers waive tolls and give a fair price. Fees 40% lower, buy 6% cheaper.

perks.name: Caravan Master
perks.description: You load a pack-horse like no other. Carry a third more.

perks.name: Master Merchant
perks.description: A name known in three kingdoms. Buy 10% cheaper and sell 10% dearer.

perks.name: Merchant Prince
perks.description: Lords grant you passage free of toll. No market fees and 6% better prices.

perks.name: Careful Accounts
perks.description: Every farthing written down. Fees and dues cost you 10% less.

perks.name: The Reeve's Ear
perks.description: You know how to argue with the manor court. Fines are 30% lighter.

perks.name: Estate Planner
perks.description: You time every task on your holdings well. Harvests are 6% larger.

perks.name: Rent Collector
perks.description: Tenants pay on the day. Rents you collect are 10% higher.

perks.name: Bailiff's Eye
perks.description: You spot idle hands and short measures. Helpers work 10% harder and harvests grow 10%.

perks.name: Law of the Manor
perks.description: You quote custom and precedent. Fines are halved.

perks.name: Steward of Note
perks.description: Great lords want you. Harvests 12% larger and wages you earn 10% higher.

perks.name: Great Steward
perks.description: You run an estate like a clock. Rent 20% lower and 10% larger harvests.

perks.name: Voice of Command
perks.description: Your orders carry across the field. Helpers and household work 10% harder.

perks.name: Fair Dealer
perks.description: Men serve you gladly. Hired helpers cost 5% less in wages.

perks.name: Steady Nerve
perks.description: You keep your head when others lose theirs. Followers hold their ranks longer.

perks.name: Drillmaster
perks.description: Men trained by you learn fast. Your followers gain experience 10% faster.

perks.name: Rallying Cry
perks.description: A shout from you brings the wavering back.

perks.name: Captain of Men
perks.description: A larger company obeys you. Helpers work 15% harder.

perks.name: Warlord
perks.description: Armies march where you point.

perks.name: Born to Lead
perks.description: People follow you without being asked. Helpers work 20% harder.

perks.name: Silver Tongue
perks.description: You choose the right word. Folk warm to you faster.

perks.name: Plain Speaker
perks.description: Honest and direct. People believe what you say.

perks.name: Honeyed Words
perks.description: A compliment sweetens every bargain: 4% better prices both ways.

perks.name: Flatterer
perks.description: Superiors enjoy your company. Opinion with the great grows faster.

perks.name: Diplomat
perks.description: You find the compromise both sides can bear.

perks.name: Bluffer
perks.description: You hold a straight face over a poor hand.

perks.name: Orator
perks.description: You sway a hall full of people.

perks.name: Whispers in Court
perks.description: Courtiers tell you what the king says in private.

perks.name: Sure Footing
perks.description: You keep your feet in mud and on cobbles.

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.description: You lock shields with your neighbours and hold.

perks.name: Riposte
perks.description: A parry opens the way for a quick return.

perks.name: Brutal Strike
perks.description: Heavy blows that stagger armoured men.

perks.name: Veteran
perks.description: You have seen worse days than this one.

perks.name: Duellist
perks.description: You fight best one against one.

perks.name: Master-at-Arms
perks.description: You teach the lords' sons.

perks.name: Champion
perks.description: Heralds name you among the best swords in the realm.

perks.name: Steady Aim
perks.description: You loose between heartbeats. Arrows scatter less.

perks.name: Quick Draw
perks.description: Nock, draw, loose in one motion. Practice at the butts teaches you 10% faster.

perks.name: Heavy Draw
perks.description: Years at the butts have built your back for a war bow. Arrows hit 10% harder.

perks.name: Wind-Reader
perks.description: Grass, smoke and banners tell you where the shaft will drift.

perks.name: Volley Fire
perks.description: On the captain's word your company darkens the sky.

perks.name: Armour-Piercer
perks.description: Bodkin points find the gap in mail.

perks.name: Master Bowman
perks.description: Yeomen speak your name with awe.

perks.name: Deadeye
perks.description: You hit what you look at.

perks.name: Firm Seat
perks.description: You sit a trot without gripping the mane.

perks.name: Gentle Rider
perks.description: Your horse tires slower under you.

perks.name: Couched Lance
perks.description: You ride home with the lance couched.

perks.name: Horse-Whisperer
perks.description: Animals trust you. Foals break easily to your hand.

perks.name: Swift Courier
perks.description: You know when to walk, trot and gallop. Journeys are 15% quicker.

perks.name: Tourney Rider
perks.description: Crowds cheer your passes.

perks.name: Master Horseman
perks.description: Journeys are 20% quicker and your stamina holds.

perks.name: Destrier Mastery
perks.description: A great horse answers your slightest signal.

perks.name: Herbalist
perks.description: Comfrey, yarrow and willow-bark from the hedgerow. Your care mends 15% more.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.description: You bind a wound without making it worse. Bleeding is stopped more reliably.

perks.name: Bone-Setter
perks.description: Fractures knit straight under your splints. Care mends 20% more.

perks.name: Fever Physic
perks.description: You know a tisane for the sweating sickness. Care mends 20% more.

perks.name: Surgeon
perks.description: You cut, cauterise and stitch with a sure hand. Care mends 30% more.

perks.name: Apothecary
perks.description: Your pharmacy shelves are full and cheaply stocked. Prices 10% better, a seventh of the herbs saved.

perks.name: Master Physician
perks.description: Even bishops send for you. Care mends 40% more.

perks.name: Infirmarian
perks.description: You run a hospital ward like a monastery. Care mends 35% more and patients cost less to keep.

perks.name: Fair Hand
perks.description: Your writing is neat and quick. You learn 10% faster from books and teachers.

perks.name: Reads Latin
perks.description: Charters and psalters no longer hide from you. Clerks and stewards pay 10% more.

perks.name: Scribe
perks.description: You can copy a page an hour. Wages for clerking are 15% higher.

perks.name: Charter-Reader
perks.description: You read the small print in leases and bonds. Rents and fees are 10% lower.

perks.name: Notary
perks.description: Your seal makes a deed good. Clerks' wages are 20% higher.

perks.name: Book-Lover
perks.description: Learning comes easier on every subject: 5% more experience in all skills.

perks.name: Scholar
perks.description: You have read the schoolmen. 8% more experience in all skills.

perks.name: Clerk of the King
perks.description: You are known at court. Wages for clerking are 30% higher.

perks.name: Soft Tread
perks.description: You step where the boards do not creak.

perks.name: Light Fingers
perks.description: Purses open for you.

perks.name: Shadow-Walker
perks.description: Dusk is your cloak.

perks.name: Lock-Picker
perks.description: A bent nail opens any chest.

perks.name: Cutpurse
perks.description: A crowd at a fair is your harvest.

perks.name: Poacher's Ways
perks.description: You know every keeper's rounds. Woodland fines are cut by 30%.

perks.name: Master Thief
perks.description: Nothing is locked to you.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.description: Guards swear they saw nothing.
